en: Multi-view black-and-white postcard showing a small rural village in a hilly forested area, a guesthouse named "Gasthof zum Thüringer Wald", a church with a clock tower, an interior view of a restaurant dining room, and a wooden-framed orientation map board. The map board includes place names and walking routes in German and references the municipality of Mühlstille / Mittelschmalkalden in the Thuringian Forest region.
